## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and intended result. Link the selected issue/roadmap item.

## Scope and ownership

Name the existing owner and affected files/contracts; explain a new owner only if there is a distinct gap. Preserve unrelated work and upstream notices. Do not include private profile/account data or secret-bearing logs.

## Evidence and remaining work

State exactly what source was inspected, which checks were written and which operations actually ran. Mark tests/builds/evaluations not run when applicable; never copy historical results as current evidence. Name missing app/access, installation/indexing/discovery and release prerequisites.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe material setup/behavior changes and the scoped rollback target. Source changes do not authorize installation, QMD/cloud sync, account actions, deployment or publication. No automatic test, reviewer or release is requested by this template.
